privacy.ai_training_note: Product uses a neural network trained once at startup by the user selecting 50 color preferences. The model is trained locally in the browser. No evidence of ongoing training on user-generated palettes or sharing of user data for model retraining. Local-storage-only architecture suggests no server-side data collection or training.
sources: https://khroma.co (homepage text: 'By choosing a set of colors, you'll train a neural network powered algorithm... right in your browser.')

security.name: Data Storage Location
security.value: Browser local storage only. No cloud backend, no server-side storage of user data, no accounts.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: HTTPS on khroma.co (standard TLS). No explicit encryption statement from vendor.

security.name: Authentication
security.value: No authentication required. Product is public, no user accounts.

security.name: Data Deletion
security.value: User controls deletion via browser local storage management. No vendor-provided account deletion or data erasure mechanism (no accounts exist).

products.name: Khroma Color Palette Generator
products.data_scope: User color selections and generated palettes stored in browser local storage only. No personal identifiable information collected or stored. No user accounts.
products.notes: Free, browser-based tool. Neural network training happens locally in user's browser. Palettes can be exported/imported manually. No cloud sync or account-based persistence.

compare.pricing_model: Free (no premium tiers, no monetization model published)

flags: No privacy policy, terms of service, or legal documentation published on khroma.co. This is a gap for any web product, even free ones, though the local-storage-only architecture mitigates some risk.

Founder-led solo/small team project with minimal public company structure information. No disclosed team size, funding, or organizational details beyond LinkedIn profile.
AI model training posture is privacy-friendly (local, browser-only), but no formal data handling or AI governance documentation (ISO/IEC 42001, CSA STAR AI) published.
Free pricing model with no disclosed revenue or business sustainability plan. Risk of service discontinuation without notice.
